Wait for drift on a workspace: objects the engine saw change outside Turf between convergences, confirmed and classified as drift notices (status shows them too). Returns when there is something new to act on — an open drift notice the cursor has not reported — with outcome drift: the drift block (each address with its class and changed attribute paths, never values; new ones marked), a cursor, and next: the up that acts on it, whose plan is then called with refresh_drift: true. A notice clearing wakes nobody. Without a cursor anything open is new and the call returns at once (a catch-up: the note says when the notices were already open before the call); cursor 'now' waits only for what opens after the call begins. Waits server-side up to the server's deadline (the waiting note says how long; progress notifications go out meanwhile when the call carries a progress token), then returns outcome waiting with a new cursor and next: the same watch — call it again. for bounds the whole watch (outcome quiet, ended, when it passes with nothing new); quiet_for holds the drift back until it has been still that long; wake_on picks the classes. A workspace nothing watches (drift not configured, or an engine without drift detection) returns at once, ended: do not call watch on it again.

**[Tiers](/docs/reference/server/#tiers):** read · plan · apply · full

## Annotations

| Annotation | Value |
|---|---|
| `readOnlyHint` | true |
| `destructiveHint` | false |
| `idempotentHint` | false |
| `openWorldHint` | false |

## Arguments

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `workspace_alias` | string | no | Workspace alias, as 'open' named it. Omit for the workspace opened without an alias ('default'). |
| `cursor` | string | no | The cursor from the last watch result: what it reported, so the watch wakes only on what is new since. 'now': take what is open as this call begins as reported, and wait only for what opens after. Omit to catch up: anything open is new, and the call returns at once. |
| `quiet_for` | integer | no | Seconds the open drift must have been still (no new signal, no new read, by the engine's clock) before the watch returns it (default 0). Use it to let a burst settle, or to leave room for someone who may be mid-change. |
| `wake_on` | string | no | Which drift notices wake the watch: 'confirmed' (default) — gone, configured, referenced, contended and uncovered, leaving unconfirmed ones to the engine's confirm (unless nothing will confirm them — no standing seal, or confirm turned off — then those too); 'any' — every class. |
| `for` | integer | no | Total seconds to keep watching, counted from the first call of this watch (the cursor carries it). Past it with nothing new the watch ends 'quiet'. Omit to watch until something drifts. |
